OTTER RAPIDS - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA4.0.

Float down a branching river. Paddle around scattered rocks, logs, whirlpools
and crocodile shadows. Catch EVERY golden fish: missing one ends your run.
Current streaks show sideways pushes. Choose either channel around islands;
fish only appear in the common river, with time to approach and rejoin.
Crocodile shadows surface and bite if touched. Speed gradually rises to a cap.

Run OtterRapids.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls             Gamepad                  Keyboard
  paddle             Left / Right             Left / Right arrows
  start / title      A or Start               X or Enter
  pause / resume     Select or Start          Backspace or Esc
  player2 joins      A on pad2                H (B/G leaves)
  player2 paddles    Left / Right on pad2      A / D
  players3/4         A on their pads to join, B to leave on title

One shared river for up to four players. Full-size otters, independent
collisions, no player collisions. Survival and collected fish earn points;
results rank everyone. Fish can be collected independently by each player.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: OtterRapids.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen.
Best score is saved in otterrapids.srm next to the exe.
